mentions.name: semiconductor.review
mentions.description: A component-monitoring tool for hardware engineers: users upload bills of materials (BOMs) and immediately get information about their components, such as manufacturer errata and components whose lifecycle is nearing its end. It is already in use at the author's company, where it has saved time and money.
mentions.problem: As a principal hardware engineer, the author needed an easy way to know when manufacturers post errata about components used in his projects or when a component used for 10+ years is nearing end of life.
mentions.audience: Engineers and companies that need to track electronic components used in their hardware projects.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have made it simple so I can upload my BOMs and know immediately about the components.
There´s of course a lot of work needed to be done and everything is inefficient but we can already use it in our company, it already has saved us a lot of time and money.
Its called semiconductor.review6 <- 6 added to prevent bots.
